text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Tsuru-chan.
Tomorrow is the Fan Appreciation Festival, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi is totally different this year!
I'm gonna compete in the same events as Spe-chan and the others!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even if there's a gap, we can compete and learn from them!
No matter the opportunity... I'll put in the effort to catch up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~ I am fired up as well~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on the day of the Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival,
the event Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi chose was...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the time has come!
It's the "Generation Pole Tug-of-War"!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text: This year's matchup is especially fierce!! The first-year Senior Class squad, riding high on momentum, is confronted head-on by the majestic second-year Senior Class squad!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We are one team!
Let's blow our upperclassmen right out of the water!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Oh dear...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What a dazed expression...
Even though she took the initiative to enter the gate first.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion~! Spe-chan, which events are you guys planning to enter~?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Put my name in there too, pleaseee!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I never imagined it would be a co-op game, though...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We don't have time to cry!
Get fired up, get pumped, give it your absolute all!
Our opponent is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAAAAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Tremble in awe, girls!
The Pearl Generation has arrived~~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Howdy~~!
Here goes~~~!

text_block_list.name: Dober & Bright
text_block_list.text:
When did this sign get here...?
*Baaam*.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Dober.
When exactly do we start running in this event?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...So rich!
Wait, even Bright-san is—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes... We are rivals after all, Lady Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You are my rival.
In this match, and in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—!
......Rivals—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember me?
The one who stood as the champion of last spring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I appeared strong that day.
After all, I was desperately trying to be strong myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I heard your voice along the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"It was the voice of my roommate, who yearned for her dream
with that very same sparkling passion."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The voice of someone who, just like me, knows the pain of constantly reaching out toward one's idol.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Treading a thorn-covered path, pricked by barbs. Even so, the voice of a strong soul who refuses to be trapped in despair rings out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hearing Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's voice, the flames within me flared up.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ――...Bright-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Tsuru-chan, you are strong.
A steadfast tree stands beautifully within your heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "However, I am strong as well. In fact, I take pride in being stronger than you, you know."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I shall show you just how stubborn I can be~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Those eyes of Bright-san's...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (...The eyes...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (It's not sparkling, it's blazing...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's be rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We are rivals who compete,
boasting proudly of being better than the other.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...No matter the contest, I will be the victor.
For I am an Umamusume far stronger than you.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much for your help around the time of the 'Kikuka Sho'.
Thanks to you, I was able to borrow the strength of everyone in the Mejiro family."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The feeling is mutual.
Gratitude aside, a race is a race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Nothing will stop me from winning consecutive victories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (PIIIIIIIII!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the “Inter-Generational Stick Pull,”
the team that pulls more of the 9 poles placed in the center into their territory wins!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text: Now, let the match—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Start!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Alright, off they go!
The first pole the Umamusume are heading towards is—

text_block_list.name: All of Tsuyoshi's Classmates
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Huh? What!
My goodness! Huh?! Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What's this?!
A tactical blunder from Special Week's generation!
They've all rushed for the exact same single pole!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Thanks for the Very Berry Light Bar!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm aiming for the left post!
Someone back me up!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, the senior generation dispersed cleanly! Stealing poles one by one, they steadily carry them back to their base!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh...
Grass, let's split up too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan and the rest, go snatch Dober-senpai's pole!
Tsuru-chan, I'll leave this one here to you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh. But I can't leave Tsuru-chan alone—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No time to hesitate!
Let's go, Spe-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Then I suppose Lady Tsuru-chan and I
will have to fight over this one~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Bright-san!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you!
I'm taking this baton!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, a struggle has finally begun in the center!
A matchup between Mejiro Bright and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi has occurred!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa.
I knew it, I should go back up Tsuru-chan—!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, focus!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I haven't forgotten the sensations from the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Bright-san!
I—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I want to etch my strength into your mind, too!
I want you to be jealous of how strong I am!
Jealous of the me who stood in the exact same place as you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because—I do too! Even more so than you!!
I have an "absolute" strength that I can stand proud of before you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
――! We know that!
And that is precisely why we――!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, what's going to happen, what just happened in the
'Generational Pole Pull Battle'?! The victor is――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text: The winners are the 2nd-year Senior-class squad~~!

text_block_list.name: Bright & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We wooooon~.
We loooost......

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOO!
One more... One more time--!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No. Let us accept our defeat gracefully.
For victory is better served than howling in despair.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh man…… You're strict as always, Grass-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan,
Tsuru-chan kept on fighting after that, too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. That's right!
I saw it too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan didn't back down at all,
even against Bright-san...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ――...She's grown stronger.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I gooooot iiiiiiiiiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text: The winners are the 1st-year Senior-class squad~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! I won, I won!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice, Tsuru-chan!
Not giving up that single spot... Leaving it to you was the right call!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh.
When the time comes, this horse girl delivers...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Oh my, oh my...♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That was magnificent~. To think Tsuru-chan
would take a point off of Bright-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah!
Thanks to that, we won!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Tsuru-chan!
I bet you're gonna do great in your next race, too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh. Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan's next race
is the Tenno Sho (Spring), just like us, right?
